episodes.synopsis: Empress wakes up in a research lab.
episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Mechanics

episodes.synopsis: Norito asks Empress to bring supplies from a nearby hospital, but a Beehive lies there.
episodes.title: Shooter Meets Hacker

episodes.synopsis: Upon saving Momiji from the Educational Institution, Empress attempts rescue of her friends.
episodes.title: Master Sniper

episodes.synopsis: Empress learns they've got a month until the Orbital Elevator is complete. Dead Master re-appears.
episodes.title: Black Falls Down a Hole

episodes.synopsis: Norito asks Strength for help, but soldiers show up. Strength purges a part of herself.
episodes.title: Drink Because You Are Happy

episodes.synopsis: Strength and Norito burst into the carrier to save Miya. They also find Lunatic.
episodes.title: Collapse

episodes.synopsis: Black Trike can't self-repair, so they go to the Peacebuilding Force Memorial Library for the parts.
episodes.title: Peacebuilding Force Memorial Library

episodes.synopsis: Empress and the others are crossing the Iron Ocean. She notices Monica is acting strange.
episodes.title: Crossing Iron Oceans

episodes.synopsis: Empress wakes up in Light House No. 8.
episodes.title: Half Mechanic

episodes.synopsis: Battle continues at Light House No. 8. The colonel is attacked by Charlotte, but Empress arrives.
episodes.title: Titanomachia

episodes.synopsis: The colonel receives a message that the Iron Ocean is spreading, causing much confusion. Despite a message confirming that the Orbital Elevator is connected, the colonel tells everyone the plan is to get Empress close to the Elevator to destroy it. At the eleventh hour, the Peacebuilding Force begins their bombardment and the final battle begins.
episodes.title: The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress

episodes.synopsis: The deadly battle unfolds in the wastelands. Empress rejects Lunatic's offer, and makes it clear that she will fight to the very end. The colonel suffers a drone barrage and faces death. Strength and Dead Master have also sustained heavy damage, and the army is all but destroyed. Is there a way out of this hopeless situation?
episodes.title: Black Rock Shooter
